answer: The falcon counter is kept in nectar and ocean shows each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 846 identities would post 2278 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
